_DESIGN_RULE: Exactly 3 categories x 3 interests = 9, and every interest has exactly one product answering it in products.json. The count is load-bearing: appeal = config.appeal_step x (interest_count - rank), so a 10th interest silently reflates every appeal number in the game. If you must change the count, expect to retune every LINE with it. Categories exist so a read can hand you PARTIAL information - 'they are a Vehicle person' is worth a tick precisely because it narrows nine to three rather than to one.
